import { readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync } from &#39;node:fs&#39;;
import { join } from &#39;node:path&#39;;
import { checkFilenameComponent } from &#39;./scripts/lint-filenames.mjs&#39;;

const FORBIDDEN = new Set(&#39;&lt;&gt;:\&#34;|?*\\\\/&#39;);
const dirs = [&#39;content/english/notes&#39;, &#39;content/english/blog&#39;];
const hits = [];

function walkAliases(val, file) {
  if (typeof val === &#39;string&#39;) {
  const trimmed = val.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, &#39;&#39;);
  const parts = trimmed.split(&#39;/&#39;);
  for (const part of parts) {
    if (!part) continue;
    const issues = checkFilenameComponent(part);
    const hasSlash = val.includes(&#39;/&#39;) || val.includes(&#39;\\\\&#39;);
    if (issues.length || hasSlash) {
      hits.push({ file, alias: val, part, issues, hasSlash });
    }
  }
  // also check full alias for colon etc in non-path aliases
  if (!val.includes(&#39;/&#39;)) {
    for (const c of val) {
      if (FORBIDDEN.has(c)) {
        const issues = checkFilenameComponent(val);
        if (issues.length) hits.push({ file, alias: val, part: val, issues, hasSlash: false });
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  }
}

function parseAliases(content, file) {
  const m = content.match(/^aliases:\s*(.+)$/m);
  if (!m) return;
  const line = m[1].trim();
  if (line.startsWith(&#39;[&#39;)) {
    try {
      const arr = JSON.parse(line.replace(/&#39;/g, &#39;\&#34;&#39;));
      arr.forEach(a =&gt; walkAliases(a, file));
    } catch {
      const items = line.match(/\&#34;([^\&#34;]+)\&#34;/g) || [];
      items.forEach(s =&gt; walkAliases(s.slice(1,-1), file));
    }
  }
}

for (const dir of dirs) {
  for (const f of readdirSync(dir)) {
    if (!f.endsWith(&#39;.md&#39;)) continue;
    const path = join(dir, f);
    parseAliases(readFileSync(path, &#39;utf8&#39;), path);
  }
}

// dedupe
const seen = new Set();
const unique = hits.filter(h =&gt; {
  const k = h.file + &#39;|&#39; + h.alias;
  if (seen.has(k)) return false;
  seen.add(k);
  return true;

```bash
cd /home/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com && node -e "
import { readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { checkFilenameComponent } from './scripts/lint-filenames.mjs';

const FORBIDDEN = new Set('<>:\"|?*\\\\/');
const dirs = ['content/english/notes', 'content/english/blog'];
const hits = [];

function walkAliases(val, file) {
  if (typeof val === 'string') {
  const trimmed = val.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '');
  const parts = trimmed.split('/');
  for (const part of parts) {
    if (!part) continue;
    const issues = checkFilenameComponent(part);
    const hasSlash = val.includes('/') || val.includes('\\\\');
    if (issues.length || hasSlash) {
      hits.push({ file, alias: val, part, issues, hasSlash });
    }
  }
  // also check full alias for colon etc in non-path aliases
  if (!val.includes('/')) {
    for (const c of val) {
      if (FORBIDDEN.has(c)) {
        const issues = checkFilenameComponent(val);
        if (issues.length) hits.push({ file, alias: val, part: val, issues, hasSlash: false });
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  }
}

function parseAliases(content, file) {
  const m = content.match(/^aliases:\s*(.+)$/m);
  if (!m) return;
  const line = m[1].trim();
  if (line.startsWith('[')) {
    try {
      const arr = JSON.parse(line.replace(/'/g, '\"'));
      arr.forEach(a => walkAliases(a, file));
    } catch {
      const items = line.match(/\"([^\"]+)\"/g) || [];
      items.forEach(s => walkAliases(s.slice(1,-1), file));
    }
  }
}

for (const dir of dirs) {
  for (const f of readdirSync(dir)) {
    if (!f.endsWith('.md')) continue;
    const path = join(dir, f);
    parseAliases(readFileSync(path, 'utf8'), path);
  }
}

// dedupe
const seen = new Set();
const unique = hits.filter(h => {
  const k = h.file + '|' + h.alias;
  if (seen.has(k)) return false;
  seen.add(k);
  return true;
});

unique.sort((a,b) => a.file.localeCompare(b.file));
for (const h of unique) {
  console.log(h.file);
  console.log('  alias:', JSON.stringify(h.alias));
  if (h.issues.length) console.log('  issues:', h.issues.join(', '));
  if (h.hasSlash) console.log('  has path separator');
}
console.log('---');
console.log('Total:', unique.length);
"
```
